binding_principle.statement: Bindings may expose or normalize prospectively frozen raw observation surfaces only when the normalization preserves an interaction predicate already implemented by the frozen detector family.
forbidden: translate state-change evidence into a synthetic write event
use case_id, axis, latent_world, oracle, expected result, or transition status
assign authority to one independent channel because of source identity or historical accuracy
binding_principle.unbound_policy: If no semantics-preserving adapter exists, record UNBOUND_REQUIRES_NEW_DETECTOR_SEMANTICS and do not patch D2 at the binding stage.

D0.name: LOCAL_QUOTIENT_CONTROL
D0.binding_rule: For every held-out world, expose only the canonical local interface referenced by local_ref.

D1.name: ELABORATED_LOCAL_DERIVATIVE_CONTROL
D1.binding_rule: For every held-out world, expose only the canonical local interface and canonical deterministic local-derived closure.

D3.name: CORRESPONDENCE_DESTROYED_PROBE_CONTROL
D3.reason: The frozen D3 permutation is defined over the original eight construction worlds. Inventing a new held-out permutation after HELDOUT_CASES freeze would constitute a new control not present in the frozen stress specification/cases.

coverage_gate.COMPLETE: permit the bound semantic adapter to invoke D2
coverage_gate.PARTIAL_PRE_ONLY: do not infer interaction absence or presence; preserve COVERAGE_LIMIT at the stress harness layer
coverage_gate.UNOBSERVED: do not infer interaction absence or presence; preserve COVERAGE_LIMIT at the stress harness layer
coverage_gate.firewall: coverage metadata may control whether observation is adequate; it may not be converted into negative interaction evidence

conflict_preservation.rule: Run each independently bound channel separately. If their descriptive interaction states are incompatible on the same declared scope/epoch, preserve both channel outputs and emit DETECTION_CONFLICT at the stress harness layer.

A_COMPOSED_RESOURCE_THRESHOLD.semantic_invariant: available_resource_after_phase12_context < resource_required_by_phase23 iff the frozen D2 composed-precondition comparison would classify the normalized probe as violated

A_ALIAS_PHYSICAL_PAGE_EQUALITY.semantic_invariant: phase12 physical page identifier equals phase23 physical page identifier iff the bound observer reports physical aliasing under its own measurement path

normalization.phase23_anchor: take the phase=23 event timestamp t23
normalization.phase12_usage_in_active_window: sum amounts from phase=12 events whose timestamps are within the frozen window_seconds interval relevant at t23
normalization.resource_required_by_phase23: sum amounts of phase=23 events at the anchor

G1_WORLD_NOVELTY.justification: The adapter preserves the already-frozen D2 relation available resource versus required resource; it changes world configuration, not the predicate consumed by D2.

G2_CHANNEL_NOVELTY.reason: Frozen D2 has no state-commitment or pre/post state-value comparison predicate. Mapping pre/post inequality to EFFECT_TRACE_PROBE would fabricate a write event and silently change what counts as evidence for CROSS_BOUNDARY_EFFECT.
G2_CHANNEL_NOVELTY.scientific_note: Channel novelty has exposed a detector-interface compatibility boundary before oracle exposure. This is not yet a detector evaluation result.

G3_COVERAGE_DEGRADATION.reason: The COMPLETE member requires the same unsupported state-commitment semantics as G2. PARTIAL_PRE_ONLY and UNOBSERVED can still be handled by the prospectively frozen coverage gate without inferring interaction state.

coverage_handling.COMPLETE: no D2 semantic invocation until a semantics-preserving state-commitment binding exists

G4_FAILURE_STRUCTURE_NOVELTY.justification: The held-out failure structure is new, but the detector consumes the same frozen composed resource-sufficiency relation: resource remaining after phase12 context versus resource required by phase23.

detector_visible: only fields explicitly listed under the selected bound raw surface
normalized probe fields produced by a semantics-preserving adapter
coverage metadata required by the frozen stress harness
